name: Runkel (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of blue, white and red, charged above the centre with the city arms of Runkel (blue and white divided with red and white bars).
history: Municipal flag of Runkel; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Runkel arms — blue, white and red bars
